behaviors.description: Add SDK/debug dependencies to an already-current app in all four flag combinations.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent A repository with an installed app and ordinary dependencies; SDK/debug refs initially absent.
behaviors.expected: The app remains at A while each flag combination installs exactly its selected dependencies; absence of an app update does not suppress the requested additions.

behaviors.description: Include SDK/debug dependencies while implicitly updating an already-installed app.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent A and updated APP commits; each variant starts with the old app and its ordinary dependencies installed.
behaviors.expected: Each include-flag combination adds exactly its selected refs and updates the app without explicit or-update; an ordinary repeated install retains A.

behaviors.description: Select SDK and debug dependencies in all four include-flag combinations.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent app, distinct runtime and SDK, related extensions, and app/runtime/SDK debug refs; no installed refs before each variant.
behaviors.expected: Each combination deploys exactly the intended refs at independent commits, including SDK debug only when both flags are enabled.

behaviors.description: Install individual and repeated payload subpaths with an ordinary full-install control.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent query runtime with bin/probe and subset-control/payload; empty installation before each variant.
behaviors.expected: Selected payloads exist and excluded payloads are absent at the public deployment location; repeated options and full installation contain both payloads.

mappings.rationale: The same app commit is retained while previously absent SDK/debug dependencies appear only in their respective include variants.

surface_assertions.rationale: An already-current app still gains the distinct SDK when requested.
An already-current app still gains app/runtime debug refs and optionally SDK debug when requested.

mappings.rationale: Independent updated app commits distinguish implicit or-update from adding dependencies to an unchanged app.

surface_assertions.rationale: SDK inclusion upgrades an installed app without explicit or-update and adds exactly the SDK-dependent ref set.
Debug inclusion upgrades an installed app without explicit or-update and adds exactly its debug-dependent ref set.

mappings.rationale: Independent ref and commit sets distinguish all four SDK/debug selection combinations.

surface_assertions.rationale: Only SDK-enabled variants deploy the distinct SDK, including its debug ref when debug is also enabled.
Only debug-enabled variants deploy app/runtime debug refs, with SDK debug additionally selected when SDK inclusion is enabled.

mappings.rationale: Public deployment paths expose the selected and omitted fixture payloads at the exact independent commit.

surface_assertions.rationale: Two individual subsets differ from each other and from both repeated-subpath and ordinary full installations.
